title: Disco Poster Studies
description: Nine independent 70s disco-era supergraphic posters — each dominated by a single oversized letter, numeral, or motif cropped to the frame edge, using hot pink, deep purple, gold, and rainbow speed stripes.
creative_direction: Every poster is built around one giant character or object that fills 60%+ of the frame. Shared grammar: hot pink / deep purple / gold / rainbow stripes / mirrorball gleam / glossy vinyl texture. The supergraphic is the composition itself, not decoration.
